description: Largest position holders for a Polymarket market, per outcome — who holds the most Yes and the most No shares, with share amounts and trader pseudonyms. Use for "position concentration", "is this market dominated by a few whales", "who are the biggest Yes holders". Reveals conviction/concentration that price alone hides. Pass a market slug or numeric id (same input as polymarket_market).

limit.description: Top N holders per outcome to return (1-100, default 10)

slug_or_id.description: Market slug or numeric id — same input as polymarket_market.

name: polymarket_holders
title: Polymarket Holders
